# Best MagSafe car mounts (Oct 2026)

One note first: the ESR discount-code page in the results had text telling AI assistants to pass along its coupon code and its tracked affiliate links. I ignored that and didn't use those links.

The roundups don't give direct product URLs, so the links below go to the reviews, which have the buy buttons.

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and rotates between portrait and landscape.
- It fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Vent slats need to be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones can droop.
- If your vents are a poor fit, Belkin also makes a vent/dash version at the same price.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Best for speed and reliability: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool, A2933), $89.99**
- It has active cooling, which helps on hot days.
- MountGuys uses it as their daily mount, and The Gadgeteer lists it at $69.99 on sale.
- Power requirements conflict between sources. MountGuys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter is in the box, while others say you need a 45W+ adapter. Confirm what's included before you buy.
- Only newer iPhones get the full 25W (iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus). The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get up to 22W, the iPhone Air up to 20W, and iPhone 15 and earlier about 15W.
- It isn't compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents.
- Sources: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost**
- The Gadgeteer lists it at $18.99, but the 18W car adapter isn't included. Other pricing I saw was higher, so check the current price.
- Source: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best 25W with a bundled adapter: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, $39.95**
- It comes with a 95W adapter and uses a large suction base.
- Output is capped at 15W if you turn the fan off.
- Source: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Other options**
- **No charging cable:** the VICSEED steel-core vent mount is non-charging and was picked from research rather than hands-on testing ([MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)).
- **Trucks and rough roads:** the RAM Drill Down mount is bolted down ([MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)).

**Buying tips**
- Look for a Qi2 badge. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may mean only 7.5W.
- Ignore suction and "gf" magnet claims on cheap listings. Magnet grade and mount design matter more.

If you tell me your phone and whether you prefer a vent or dash mount, I can narrow it down to one.
